summary: 博弈论软件把各方可能的选择放进同一模型，帮助分析拍卖、竞标与谈判。作者借咨询和商业案例展示模型怎样改变决策，并追问它能否用于更复杂的调解。
logic: 借咨询模型比较谈判方案
探讨更广泛的调解用途

paragraphs.brief: 根据游戏理论，我们在谈判中取得成功的机会取决于其他人的选择。
sentences: According to game theory, our chances of success in negotiations are based on the choices of others.
根据游戏理论，我们在谈判中取得成功的机会取决于其他人的选择。
Computer models have been developed to work out how events will unfold as people and organisations act in what they perceive to be their own best interests.
已经开发了计算机模型，以确定随着人们和组织按照他们认为是自身最佳利益的方式行事，事件将如何展开。
Numerical values are placed on the goals, motivations and influence of players, and likely options are considered.
数字价值被放在参与者的目标、动机和影响上，并可能考虑各种选择。
Game-theory software then evaluates the ability of each of those players to influence others, and hence predicts the course of events.
游戏理论软件然后评估每个玩家影响他人的能力，从而预测事件的过程。

paragraphs.brief: 因此，利用游戏理论模拟行为在应用到经济学时证明特别有用。
sentences: Although many individuals would feel uncomfortable having a computer make decisions for them, many organisations run such computer simulations for law firms, companies and governments.
虽然许多个人会感到不舒服让计算机为他们做出决策，但许多组织为律师事务所，公司和政府运行了这样的计算机模拟
But feeding software with accurate data on all the players involved is especially tricky for political matters.
但用准确的软件输入所有参与者的数据在政治问题上特别困难。

Reinier van Oosten of Decide, a Dutch firm that models political negotiations, notes that predictions may become unreliable when people unexpectedly give in to ‘non-rational emotions’, such as hatred, rather than pursuing what is apparently in their best interests.
荷兰一家以政治谈判为模式的公司Reinier van Oosten of Decition指出，当人们意外地屈服于仇恨等`非理性情绪 ' 时，预测就可能变得不可靠，而不是追求显然符合其最大利益的东西。
However, sorting out people’s motivations is much easier when making money is the main object.
但是，在赚钱时，要查明人们的动机容易得多。
Accordingly, modelling behaviour using game theory is proving especially useful when applied to economics.
因此，利用游戏理论模拟行为在应用到经济学时证明特别有用。

paragraphs.brief: 使用游戏理论软件来模拟拍卖会非常有利可图。
sentences: Using game-theory software to model auctions can be very lucrative.
使用游戏理论软件来模拟拍卖会非常有利可图。
Consulting firms are entering the market to help clients design profitable auctions, or to win them less expensively.
咨询公司正在进入市场，帮助客户设计有利可图的拍卖，或以较低的价格赢得这些拍卖。

In 2006, in the run-up to an online auction of radio-spectrum licences by America’s Federal Communications Commission, Dr Paul Milgrom, a consultant and Stanford University professor in the United States, customised his game-theory software to assist a consortium of bidders.
2006年，在美国联邦通信委员会在线拍卖无线电频谱许可证的过程中，美国斯坦福大学的顾问和教授Paul Milgrom博士定制了他的游戏理论软件，以协助投标人集团。
He was apprehensive at first, but the result was a triumph.
他一开始很担心，但结果却取得了胜利。
When the auction began, Milgrom’s software tracked competitors’ bids to estimate their budgets for the 1,132 licences on offer.
当拍卖开始时，米尔格罗姆的软件跟踪了竞争对手的报价，以估计他们对1132个许可证的预算。
Crucially, the software estimated the secret values bidders placed on specific licences, and determined that certain big licences were being over-valued.
关键是，软件估计了特定许可证上的秘密价值投标人，确定某些大许可证的价值过高。
Milgrom’s clients were then directed to obtain a collection of smaller, less-expensive licences instead.
然后指示Milgrom的客户获得一批较小的、费用较低的许可证。
Two of his clients paid about a third less than their competitors for an equivalent amount of spectrum, saving almost $1.2 billion.
他的两个客户支付的费用比竞争对手的三分之一要少，其频谱相当，节省了近12亿美元。
Such a saving makes one wonder why everyone isn’t using game-theory software.
如此节约，人们会想知道为什么每个人都不使用游戏理论软件。
And, if they were, how would that affect the game?
如果是这样，那会影响比赛吗？

paragraphs.brief: PA Consulting是一家英国公司，根据游戏理论设计软件模型，帮助客户解决从制药到制作电视节目等领域的具体问题。
sentences: PA Consulting, a British firm, designs models for software based on game theory to help its clients solve specific problems in areas from pharmaceuticals to the production of television shows.
PA Consulting是一家英国公司，根据游戏理论设计软件模型，帮助客户解决从制药到制作电视节目等领域的具体问题。
British government agencies have asked PA Consulting to build models to test zoning rules that govern how many of a certain type of business should be allowed to operate in one area.
英国政府机构已要求巴勒斯坦权力机构咨询公司建立模式，以测试关于某一类企业中有多少企业应获准在一个地区经营的分区规则。
To give a simple example: if two competing ice-cream sellers share a long beach, they will set up stalls back-to-back in the middle and stay put, explains Dr Stephen Black, a modeller for PA.
Stephen Black医生，PA的模特儿解释一下：“举一个简单的例子：如果两个相互竞争的冰淇淋销售商共享一个漫长的海滩，他们就会把摊位背靠背地放在中间并保持原地。”
Unfortunately for potential customers at the far ends of the beach, each seller prevents the other from relocating—no other spot would be closer to more people.
不幸的是，对于海滩最远处的潜在客户来说，每个卖方都阻止对方搬迁——没有其他地方会更接近更多的人。
Introduce a third seller, however, and the stifling equilibrium is broken as relocations and pricing changes energise the market.
但是，引入第三卖方，随着搬迁和价格变动使市场陷入困境，窒息性平衡被打破。
By studying a chain of events such as this, software designers can assess the effect of change and see the patterns in possible outcomes that may occur.
软件设计师通过研究类似事件链，可以评估变化的影响，并看到可能出现的结果模式。
As a result, the use of modelling makes clients more inclined to look at future repercussions when making business decisions, Black says.
布莱克说：“因此，使用模型使客户更愿意在作出商业决定时考虑未来的影响。”

paragraphs.brief: Ponsatí现为西班牙巴塞罗那自治大学经济分析研究所所长，他说，可以使用这种 " 调解机器 "，通过解开否则会向对手隐瞒的信息，推动谈判。
sentences: Where is all this heading?
这一切往哪里去？
Alongside the increasingly elaborate modelling software, there are also efforts to develop software that can assist in negotiation and mediation.
除了日益完善的模拟软件外，还努力开发能够协助谈判和调解的软件。
Two decades ago, Dr Clara Ponsatí, a Spanish academic, came up with a clever idea.
20年前，西班牙学者克拉拉·庞萨蒂博士提出了一个聪明的想法。
She accepted that, as negotiators everywhere know, the first side to disclose the maximum amount that it is willing to pay loses considerable bargaining power.
她承认，正如世界各地的谈判者所知道的那样，披露其愿意支付的最大数额的第一面会丧失相当大的谈判能力。
Without leverage, it can be pushed backward in the bargaining process by a clever opponent.
没有杠杆作用，它可以被一个聪明的对手推向谈判的后退。
But if neither side reveals the concessions it is prepared to make, negotiations can become very slow or collapse.
但是，如果任何一方都不透露它准备作出的让步，谈判就会变得非常缓慢或崩溃。
However, difficult negotiations can often be pushed along by neutral mediators, especially if they are entrusted with the secret bottom lines of all parties.
但是，中立调解人往往可以推动艰难的谈判，特别是如果他们被赋予各方的秘密底线。
Ponsatí’s idea was that if a human mediator was not trusted, affordable or available, a computer could do the job instead.
Ponsatós认为，如果一个人类调解人得不到信任、价格低廉或可得到，那么计算机可以代替它来工作。
Negotiating parties would update the software with the confidential information on their bargaining positions after each round of talks.
谈判各方将在每轮会谈后更新软件，提供其谈判立场的机密信息。
Once positions on both sides were no longer mutually exclusive, the software would be used to split the difference and propose an agreement.
一旦双方的立场不再相互排斥，该软件将用来分割分歧并提议达成协议。

Ponsatí, now head of the Institute of Economic Analysis at the Autonomous University of Barcelona in Spain, says such ‘mediation machines’ could be employed to push negotiations forward by unlocking information that would otherwise be withheld from an opponent.
Ponsatí现为西班牙巴塞罗那自治大学经济分析研究所所长，他说，可以使用这种 " 调解机器 "，通过解开否则会向对手隐瞒的信息，推动谈判。

paragraphs.brief: 利用基于游戏理论的软件，从拍卖投标和公用事业定价到解决政治和军事争端，能否实现调解？
sentences: Could mediation which has been achieved using software based on game theory spread from auction bids and utility pricing to resolving political and military disputes?
利用基于游戏理论的软件，从拍卖投标和公用事业定价到解决政治和军事争端，能否实现调解？
Today’s game-theory software is not yet sufficiently advanced to mediate between warring countries.
今天的游戏理论软件还不足以在交战国之间进行调解。
But one day opponents on the brink of war might be tempted to use it to exchange information without having to engage in conflict.
但有一天，处于战争边缘的反对者可能会被诱惑利用它来交换情报，而不必参与冲突。
According to some game theorists, opponents could learn how a war would turn out, skip the fighting and strike a deal.
根据一些游戏理论家的说法对手可以知道战争会如何结束跳过战斗达成交易
Over-optimistic, perhaps—but game theorists do have rather an impressive track record when it comes to predicting the future.
但游戏理论家在预测未来时确实有着相当令人印象深刻的记录。

items.en: What does the writer suggest about game-theory software in the first paragraph?
items.zh: 作者在第一段对博弈论软件有何看法？
correct: This software anticipates the outcome of future events.
该软件预计未来活动的结果。

items.en: Reinier van Oosten says predicting what people will do works best if
items.zh: 莱尼埃·范·奥斯滕说预言如果

items.en: After using game-theory software in 2006, Dr Milgrom instructed his clients to
items.zh: 米尔格罗姆博士在2006年使用博弈论软件后，建议客户……

items.en: The writer refers to Stephen Black’s ice-cream-seller example in order to
items.zh: 作者引用史蒂芬·布莱克的冰淇淋卖家例子
correct: show the impact new competitors have on business.
显示新的竞争对手对商业的影响。

items.en: Ponsatí believes business negotiations are more likely to progress if
items.zh: 波萨蒂认为，如果商业谈判更有可能取得进展,
correct: mediators or computers take over the bargaining process.
调解人或计算机接管谈判过程。

items.en: Game-theory software may be unhelpful when dealing with political issues.
items.zh: 在处理政治问题时，博弈论软件可能帮不上忙。
items.why: 政治问题尤其难以获得涉及各方的准确资料，而软件需要这些输入才能可靠建模，所以在政治事务上它可能帮不上忙。

items.en: Dr Milgrom was confident about applying his software to an auction in 2006.
items.zh: Milgrom博士对在2006年的拍卖中应用软件充满信心。
items.why: 1.2 题干说他 confident,原文相反 (apprehensive = 不安)

items.en: Dr Ponsatí believes ‘mediation machines’ are an inappropriate method of negotiation in areas other than business.
items.zh: Ponsatí博士认为，“调解机器”在商业以外领域是一种不适当的谈判方法。
items.why: 庞萨提认为调解机器可能帮助谈判双方说出原本保留的信息。她没有断言这种方式在商业以外的领域不合适。

items.en: Military organisations refuse to accept that software based on game theory could prevent wars.
items.zh: 军方不愿承认，基于博弈论的软件有可能防止战争。
items.why: 作者判断现阶段的软件还不足以调解交战国家之间的冲突。技术目前能否做到，与军事组织是否拒绝接受这种可能，是两个问题。

groups.label: 观点判断 · YES / NO / NOT GIVEN

items.en: According to Reinier van Oosten, game-theory software fails when
items.zh: 雷尼尔·范奥斯滕认为，博弈论软件会在什么情况下失效？
items.answer: E · people allow their feelings to influence decisions
items.solution: 人让自己的感情影响决定

items.en: Dr Milgrom’s software is successful in detecting if
items.zh: Milgrom博士的软件成功检测到
items.answer: A · something is thought to be worth more than it really is
items.solution: 有些东西被认为比真的值钱

items.en: Dr Black’s game-theory software is a helpful tool when
items.zh: 在什么情况下，布莱克博士的博弈论软件能派上用场？
items.answer: D · businesses consider possible future developments
items.solution: 企业考虑未来可能的发展

items.en: According to Dr Ponsatí, negotiators fall behind if
items.answer: C · too much information is given to the other parties early on
items.solution: 早些时向其他当事方提供了太多的信息

items.en: Dr Ponsatí’s mediation machine is useful when
items.answer: B · discussions between the parties begin to break down

pairs: anticipates the outcome of future events
两种说法都指软件预判事件会怎样发展。anticipate 在这里表示预见。
making money is the main object
赚钱是首要目标，也就是利润构成最主要的动机。这里的 object 指目标。
题干以米尔格罗姆为主语写“指示客户”，原文把客户放在主语位置，改用被动语态。
第 4 段 · 第 7 句
points: 1.2 题干说他 confident,原文相反 (apprehensive = 不安)
题干问“Ponsats博士的调解机器在”。定位句写到“但是，如果任何一方都不透露它准备作出的让步，谈判就会变得非常缓慢或崩溃”。
clauses: …, many organisations run such computer simulations for law firms, companies and governments.
连接词 although 引出“Although many individuals would feel uncomfortable having a computer make decisions for them”，说明主句的让步关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 although 把这一层关系补进去。
Crucially, the software estimated the secret values bidders placed on specific licences, and determined ….
“that certain big licences were being over-valued”补足 determined 的内容，交代究竟在说、判断或发现什么。
先读 determined 所在的主句，再把 that 后面的内容作为一个整体。
lead: Computer software that models human behaviour can make forecasts, outsmart rivals and transform negotiations
模拟人类行为的计算机软件可以作出预测，超越对手，改变谈判
